name: Lenga Valentine
source:
Massage Style: Acupressure
Likes: Food, surprises
Dislikes: Hungry, invariable routines

A wanderer who had lost his memory. He looks for ways to try and remember his past. He develops an interest in massaged and applies to Full Service in hopes of someone recognizing him. Often curious, he likes getting to know everyone around him. His unique style of massage is "Acupressure". While Lenga is usually cheerful and upbeat, he is sensual with his massages, and likes using various "special tools" in his sessions.

His is a protagonist of "Paradiso Guardian", a game by his original character designer Lvlv.
